reported_failure: Worldserver crashed during the middle Warlock artifact acquisition route, Dark Whispers (quest 42125), map 1498. The character was playing Destruction; the artifact route does not determine the active combat specialization.

crash_evidence.fault: C0000005 at module RVA 0x2149C3E: the deliberate null write in Trinity::Assert, not an unexplained invalid NPC pointer.
crash_evidence.assertion: SpellScript.cpp:1164, AuraScript::_IsDefaultActionPrevented is called in a wrong place
stack: Aura::UpdateOwner / Unit::_UpdateSpells / Creature::Update / map update thread
crash_evidence.dump_memory: Unwound saved RSI from the assertion frame points to the current loaded-script iterator. Its AuraScript has m_scriptSpellId 0x2F405 = 193541 and m_currentScriptState 0x19 = AURA_SCRIPT_HOOK_CHECK_PROC. The outer dispatcher had prepared AURA_SCRIPT_HOOK_EFFECT_PROC (0x1C). World spell_script_names maps 193541 to spell_warl_immolate_proc.
crash_evidence.symbol_limits: The preexisting canonical MAP was from October 14 and was not treated as a matching symbol file. A private relink of current object/library inputs produced a new MAP with shifted addresses; it was not byte-identical to the crashed image. Function identification was corroborated against original-image instruction bytes, assertion string references/line number, matching function byte sequences and dump object state. Original executable and minidump remain private.

root_cause: The production Immolate proc awards a Soul Shard fragment by casting triggered energize 193540. That can re-enter the same aura's proc checks. The energize has no matching critical Immolate damage, so CheckProc rejects it. Aura::CallScriptCheckProcHandlers returned false before _FinishScriptCall, leaving the nested CHECK_PROC state and application on the stack. The outer effect dispatcher then queried default-action suppression in CHECK_PROC and asserted. Ordinary rejected checks also accumulated stale stack entries. The area-target check dispatcher had the identical unbalanced rejection path.
implementation: Call _FinishScriptCall before either rejecting dispatcher returns false. This restores the enclosing hook, application and PreventDefaultAction flag, or the initial state for ordinary checks. Preserve short-circuit rejection, approved-check behavior, the actual Immolate handler and its critical-hit/50 percent condition. Do not suppress assertions, bypass proc checks or change quest/character data.
automated_checks: Test-AuraScriptReentry.ps1 extracts the production AuraScript hook enum/state store, prepare/finish/default-action methods, proc/area/effect dispatchers and complete spell_warl_immolate_proc class, then compiles a native C++ fixture.

With -BaselineRevision de3e3837, the real nested critical Immolate -> 193540 energize -> rejected proc path fails at the same production _IsDefaultActionPrevented assertion. The fixture reports the failure as an exception instead of crashing the test runner.

Fixed code passes 100 nested Immolate proc executions with exactly 100 fragment casts and restored default-action suppression/application/state; 1000 rejected ordinary ticks; unrelated damage and failed chance; multiple scripts and early rejection; empty checks; nested periodic/area rejection and removed-aura guards. All finished calls leave an empty state stack.
Test-WarlockRegression.ps1 passes existing Burning Rush and scripted mover regressions.
Test-ScenarioResume.ps1 -VerifyReleaseBinary passes the production fresh restart/live rejoin and login gates; canonical recovery markers are present.

Release worldserver rebuilt from the actual src/server/game/Release/game.lib into build-extractors/bin/Release. Fresh matching worldserver.map generated. Native disassembly confirms the false-check branch at preferred VA 0x141828F67 calls _FinishScriptCall through thunk 0x14006321E -> 0x14151FF30 before returning false. The success branch calls the same finish method.

Test-WorldShutdown.ps1 -ProbeConnections reaches ready, responds on both ports and exits with code 0; no new crash dumps. DBErrors remains 5309 bytes, with old historical messages preserved. Nine protected configuration/certificate/DLL/bnetserver hashes are unchanged.
reentry_limits: The existing generic recovery restarts an active quest in a fresh instance after a process crash. It does not persist exact actor/criteria state. Do not promise continuation at the precise pre-crash fight.
pending_client_checks: Relog into Dark Whispers, confirm scenario restart/re-entry, pet and normal movement, then repeat Destruction combat with critical Immolate ticks and complete acquisition of the Skull of the Man'ari.

This repair addresses the demonstrated shared aura crash. Whole-route NPC interactions, visuals, race/faction coverage and artifact completion are not established by these native tests or server startup.
